verdict.rationale:
Penpot's docs confirm the core update mechanism for components — main components link to copies so edits to the main propagate to copies, and copies can even restore a deleted main (docs-22, docs-23, docs-35, docs-11) — which is the technical basis for controlled updates. However, the evidence pack does not explicitly document a 'shared library' feature that publishes components/styles across separate files and projects (only within-file component reuse and design-token alignment are cited).

missing for 10: explicit documentation of publishing a library from one file and attaching/updating it across multiple other files/projects, and any community confirmation of cross-project library workflows.
